**Fix:** Move these properties to `Directory.Build.props` (which is imported *before* the project file), wrapped in conditional-default guards:

<PropertyGroup>
  <TreatWarningsAsErrors Condition="'$(TreatWarningsAsErrors)' == ''">true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>
  <Company Condition="'$(Company)' == ''">Contoso</Company>
  <Authors Condition="'$(Authors)' == ''">Build Team</Authors>

**Fix:** Move this property group to `Directory.Build.targets`, where `$(TargetFramework)` has been resolved:

<PropertyGroup Condition="'$(TargetFramework)' == 'net8.0'">
